notes: Dated public snapshot of the Lake Washington boys basketball Varsity, Junior Varsity and C-Team 2026–27 schedules from KingCo Athletics (WPA Network). Games without a final score are upcoming and keep points/against as null; final scores are filled in when KingCo publishes them. Rosters are the latest published KingCo rosters (2025–26); no 2026–27 roster is out yet for those levels. refPointsPerGame is the previous season's team scoring average, used only to estimate player stats before any score exists. C-Team jersey numbers, heights and positions are not published; the game assigns jersey numbers and marks them numberAssigned. Opponent rosters come from each school's KingCo/WPA team page at the same level (latest published); opponents without one get fictional names (real: false). Skills, energy, morale, GPA and all simulated statistics are fictional.
